gradeRationale: Leads only; certainty stays with the appraisal of retrieved records.
synthesis: Three further reviews recalled as leads, not found by the recorded search and not checked: a review of social prescribing for young people, a review of link worker models in deprived areas, and a review of digital social prescribing. None has been verified.

items.title: Social prescribing for children and young people: a systematic review
items.keyFindings: Few evaluations; mostly qualitative; outcomes heterogeneous.
items.limitations: Different population from the network's referrals.
items.notes: Recalled as a lead; not retrieved.

items.title: Link worker models in areas of high deprivation: a systematic review of implementation
items.keyFindings: Link workers in deprived areas had larger caseloads and fewer community activities to refer to.
items.notes: Recalled as a lead; year not known.

items.title: Digital social prescribing platforms: a scoping review
items.keyFindings: Platforms mainly used for referral tracking; outcome data sparse.

summary: Three additional review leads; none verified; one has no usable year.
